threads.body: [General] This newly routes the driver through the deprecated per-instrumentation `statement_sanitizer` fallback, but `DbConfig.getQuerySanitizationEnabled` gates that fallback with process-global `SemconvStability.v3Preview()` instead of `v3Preview(openTelemetry)`. If a custom `ExtendedOpenTelemetry` enables `common.v3_preview` while the global instance does not, the driver will now honor the removed JDBC alias and can disable sanitization unexpectedly. Pass the `OpenTelemetry` instance through to that gate and add a regression case for this mixed configuration.

replies.body:
Addressed in c5d09b4adccedc9e932d3aca0f3c281bc638a09f. Both the per-instrumentation deprecated setting and the driver’s deprecated common system-property fallback now use `v3Preview(openTelemetry)`.

Added H2 and DbConfig regressions for custom-instance preview on/off. Before the fix, the two preview-enabled H2 cases exported the literal instead of `SELECT ?`, and the DbConfig case returned false instead of true. All 87 focused tests now pass across default/stable database semantic conventions, along with scoped Spotless and Checkstyle. The deprecation suppression is also limited to the helper that uses `DB_STATEMENT`.
